title: A Kansas sunflower
done: You made a sunflower! It is the state flower of Kansas.

steps.say: Put a big purple square flat on the table. It is the middle of the sunflower. Real sunflower middles are brown; we use purple.
Put a yellow triangle on top, at the left. A petal!
Another yellow triangle on top, at the right.
A yellow triangle on the right side, at the bottom.
A yellow triangle on the right side, at the top.
A yellow triangle at the bottom, on the right.
A yellow triangle at the bottom, on the left.
A yellow triangle on the left side, at the bottom.
The last yellow triangle goes on the left side, at the top.
